# Tayyab — Full Stack Developer Portfolio

> https://thisistayyab.dev

Tayyab builds production web applications with React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, SaaS platforms, APIs, and AI automation. Co-founder and lead developer at Taylance Tech.

## Featured product — Tillqorin

Tillqorin is Taylance Tech's web POS and billing platform (Commerce OS for retail). Tayyab led full-stack development.

- Portfolio write-up: https://thisistayyab.dev/projects/tillqorin
- Product marketing: https://taylancetech.com/products/tillqorin
